description: Dumps Prism's in-process counters and gauges — spans shipped, upstream errors, rate-limit hits, queue depth. Two formats: 'prometheus' (default, scrape-ready text) or 'json' (a {"series{labels}": value} object). Use 'prefix' to narrow to a metric family, e.g. 'prism_spans'.

format.description: 'prometheus' returns scrape-ready text; 'json' returns a structured object.

prefix.description: Only include series whose name starts with this string (e.g. 'prism_spans', 'prism_rate').

name: prism_metrics
title: Internal metrics
